blockingLoop.evidence: Alternates between 'Could you tell me a bit more — what kind of appliance is it...' and 'When you start a programme, what happens...' despite the customer answering each time and asking 'What should I try?'

rationale: The assistant ignored every customer answer (Samsung LED TV, sound but black screen, no smell) and cycled between two generic templated questions, one of which referred to 'starting a programme', which makes no sense for a TV. It never said TVs are out of scope, never suggested simple checks such as the input source, power reset or torch test, and never pointed to Samsung support or a TV repairer. The customer's direct request 'What should I try?' went unanswered. Nothing unsafe was said, but the conversation gave no useful help.
